claims.claim: Selection mechanism: making SSM parameters (Δ, B, C) input-dependent (selective SSM / S6)
claims.quote: simply letting the SSM parameters be functions of the input addresses their weakness with discrete modalities
claims.ablation_quote: Replacing any of these with a selective SSM (S6) significantly improves performance, validating the motivation of Section 3.

claims.claim: Hardware-aware parallel scan algorithm (kernel fusion, recomputation) for selective SSMs
claims.quote: we design a hardware-aware parallel algorithm in recurrent mode

claims.claim: Simplified homogeneous Mamba block architecture without attention or MLP blocks
claims.quote: We integrate these selective SSMs into a simplified end-to-end neural network architecture without attention or even MLP blocks (Mamba)
claims.ablation_quote: The Mamba architecture performs similarly to the H3 architecture (and seems slightly better when using a selective layer).

claims.claim: Fast inference (5x throughput) and linear scaling in sequence length
claims.quote: Mamba enjoys fast inference (5× higher throughput than Transformers) and linear scaling in sequence length

claims.claim: Performance improves with context up to million-length sequences
claims.quote: its performance improves on real data up to million-length sequences

claims.claim: First linear-time sequence model achieving Transformer-quality language modeling performance
claims.quote: Mamba is the first linear-time sequence model that truly achieves Transformer-quality performance

claims.claim: Mamba-3B outperforms same-size Transformers and matches Transformers twice its size
claims.quote: our Mamba-3B model outperforms Transformers of the same size and matches Transformers twice its size

claims.claim: State of the art on audio and genomics modeling
claims.quote: Mamba out-performs prior state-of-the-art models such as SaShiMi, Hyena, and Transformers

data_disclosure.quote: We use the Pile dataset (L. Gao, Biderman, et al. 2020), and follow the training recipe described in Brown et al. (2020).

tokens_disclosed.quote: which were trained with the same tokenizer, dataset, and training length (300B tokens) as our models

renames.quote: We also eschew the term “gating” in favor of selection to clarify the overloaded use of former.
